questions.run:
# 0. Data the published runs used that is too large to commit (see "How a rerun can differ").
python scripts/prepare_data.py text8 --parquet PATH/afmck-text8/data \

# 2. Train and tune every case on Ray; only each case's winner sees the test split.

  $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/runs/sc-vs-depth --output $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/runs/sc-vs-depth/analysis
fixed: 20k training steps, batch 256, 8 layers × 512 wide unless the axis says 16L
128 NFE per sequence; five samplers (native, native greedy, EB greedy, renoise, renoise greedy), each tuned on validation
one training seed; the validation winner is scored once on the test split (seeds 1041, 1042)

notes: In hybrid_renoising.yaml the renoise policies are named renoising and renoising_greedy; the post calls them renoise sample and renoise greedy.

sweep.text:
# @package _global_
# Is self-conditioning just a deeper network? (experiments/sc-vs-depth)
# {Gaussian (CDCD clock), masked, uniform} x {8 layers, 8 layers + SC, 16 layers}
# x {Sudoku-hard, text8, TinyStories BPE-10k} = 27 cases, each tuned with five
# sampler policies at 128 NFE. experiments/sc-sampler-choice reads the same runs.
defaults:
- /experiment: corruption_factorial
- common
- /ablation_path: gaussian_cdcd
- /feedback: none
- /inference_policies: hybrid_renoising
- override /task: battery/sudoku_hard
- _self_
checkpoint:
  every_n_steps: 1000
data:
  # Read only by TinyStories: the story cohort the evaluation indices refer to.
  # Build it with scripts/prepare_data.py.
  allowed_ids_path: ${data.cache_dir}/allowed_ids.json
preparation:
  name: sc-vs-depth
  output: ${oc.env:SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT,${oc.env:HOME}/.cache/sddc}/plans/sc-vs-depth
  evaluation_file: experiments/sc-vs-depth/evaluation/${preparation.task_name}.json
  family: sc_vs_depth
  recipe_name: ${preparation.path_name}-${preparation.feedback_name}
  wandb:
    project: sc-vs-depth
hydra:
  sweeper:
    params:
      task: battery/sudoku_hard,battery/text8,battery/tinystories_bpe
      ablation_path: gaussian_cdcd,masked_elbo,uniform
      feedback: none,expected_embedding,double_depth

files.text:
# Excerpt: trainer, loader, training, lr_scheduler, optimizer, preparation.evaluation (135 lines in full; the rest sets W&B, Ray resources,
# the three native/EB sampler policies and Hydra output paths).
trainer:
  max_steps: 20000
  accumulate_grad_batches: 4
  precision: bf16-mixed
  val_check_interval: 4000
  num_sanity_val_steps: 0
  enable_progress_bar: false
loader:
  global_batch_size: 256
  eval_batch_size: 8
  num_workers: 2
training:
  warmup_steps: 2500
  ema: 0.9999
  performance:
    compile:
      enabled: true
      backend: inductor
      dynamic: true
lr_scheduler:
  _target_: core.training.schedules.constant_warmup
  warmup_steps: 2500
optimizer:
  lr: 0.0003
preparation:
  evaluation:
    nfe: 128
    seeds:
    - 41
    - 42
    test_seeds:
    - 1041
    - 1042

# @package _global_
# Common training assembly: one noisy view, one posterior, one CE objective.
defaults:
- override /algorithm: hybrid_diffusion
- override /model: single_view
- override /sampler: hybrid
- override /parameterization: unconstrained_posterior
- override /objective: cross_entropy
- override /time_sampler: antithetic

model:
  time:
    coordinate: time
self_conditioning:
  source: hidden
  probability: 0.9
  evaluation_probability: 1.0
trainer:
  max_steps: 10000
  val_check_interval: 1000
  # Use one precision across families (including the simplex recipe).
  precision: bf16-mixed
  enable_progress_bar: false
checkpoint:
  every_n_steps: 1000
  save_top_k: 1
# Periodic generation uses isolated RNG and EMA weights.
callback:
  every_n_steps: 1000
  subset_size: 128
sampler:
  steps: 127
  final_denoise: greedy

# @package _global_
# Gaussian embedding diffusion whose continuous clock is learned with the CDCD
# loss-CDF fitter: ablation_path=gaussian with path_schedule=cdcd, as one choice
# so a sweep can cross it with the discrete paths.
defaults:
- /gaussian_state: embedding
- /path_schedule: cdcd
preparation:
  path_name: gaussian_embedding

# @package _global_
# Masked (absorbing) diffusion trained on the ELBO (keep-rate hazard weighting), as one
# choice so a sweep can cross it with the other paths. Case names say "masked".
defaults:
- /content_view: masked
- override /objective: masked_elbo
preparation:
  path_name: masked

# @package _global_
defaults:
- /content_view: uniform
preparation:
  path_name: uniform_posterior_ce

# Masked-diffusion ELBO: token cross-entropy weighted by the keep-rate hazard
# -alpha'(t) / (1 - alpha(t)) of the content view's schedule (MDLM's weighting).
_target_: core.objectives.cross_entropy.CrossEntropy
label_smoothing: 0.0
weighting:
  _target_: core.objectives.weighting.KeepRateHazardWeighting
  schedule: ${model.views.content.schedule}

# @package _global_
# Learn the continuous view's quantile map with the CDCD loss-CDF fitter.
# The shared/discrete clock remains uniform; no legacy AdaptiveTimeMap is used.
defaults:
- override /time_sampler: cdcd
algorithm:
  adaptive_time_views: [0]
time_sampler:
  adaptive: true
  epsilon: 0.001
preparation:
  schedule_name: cdcd

# @package _global_
self_conditioning:
  enabled: false
  source: posterior_mean
model:
  n_blocks: 8
preparation:
  feedback_name: none

# @package _global_
self_conditioning:
  enabled: true
  source: posterior_mean
model:
  n_blocks: 8
preparation:
  feedback_name: expected_embedding

# @package _global_
self_conditioning:
  enabled: false
  source: posterior_mean
model:
  n_blocks: 16
preparation:
  feedback_name: double_depth

# @package _global_
# Sampler policies for single-view diffusion recipes: the native (ancestral) sampler,
# its greedy variant, entropy-bounded greedy decoding and forward re-noising (sampled
# and greedy). Each is tuned on validation; only the best one sees the test split.
preparation:
  inference:
  - name: native
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: native_greedy
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, sample]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps
    sampler_overrides:
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
  - name: eb_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.parallel_entropy_bounded.ParallelEntropyBoundedSampler
      steps: 127
      freeze: true
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
      entropy_bound: 0.1
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
      sampler.entropy_bound: {type: float, low: 0.02, high: 0.5, log: true}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
      sampler.entropy_bound: 0.1
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: renoising
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.forward_resampling.ForwardResamplingSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      greedy_clean_estimate: false
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: renoising_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.forward_resampling.ForwardResamplingSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, sample]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps

questions.question: Does the tokenizer change the picture?
questions.run:
export SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT=~/.cache/sddc   # or your storage volume
EXTRAS=(--extra tuning --extra scoring --extra tracking)

# 0. TinyStories parquet shards, then the shared story cohort. The script exits
#    non-zero unless its sha256 is f16da32a..., the cohort the committed indices use.
huggingface-cli download roneneldan/TinyStories --repo-type dataset \
  --revision f54c09fd23315a6f9c86f9dc80f725de7d8f9c64 --include 'data/*' \
  --local-dir $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/tinystories
export TINYSTORIES_DATA_DIR=$SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/tinystories/data
uv run --locked "${EXTRAS[@]}" python scripts/prepare_data.py tinystories \
  --parquet $TINYSTORIES_DATA_DIR \
  --output $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/data_cache/tinystories_bpe/allowed_ids.json

# 1. Expand the sweep into 35 cases (no training).
uv run --locked "${EXTRAS[@]}" python -m core.sweeps.prepare -m \
  +sweep=tokenizer_ladder preparation.output=$SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/plans/tokenizer-ladder
uv run --locked "${EXTRAS[@]}" python -m core.sweeps.prepare collect \
  $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/plans/tokenizer-ladder
# 2. Train each case, tune its samplers on validation, test the winner.
uv run --locked "${EXTRAS[@]}" python -m core.sweeps.nested_tuning \
  $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/plans/tokenizer-ladder/manifest.json \
  --output $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/runs/tokenizer-ladder --address auto --case-concurrency 4
# 3. The post's table (vocab_ladder.json) and a comparison with expected.csv.
uv run --locked "${EXTRAS[@]}" python experiments/tokenizer-ladder/analyze.py \
  $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/runs/tokenizer-ladder --output results/tokenizer-ladder
fixed: 20k training steps, batch 256, 8 layers × 512 wide; sequence length set per vocabulary so every story fits
128 NFE for diffusion; five samplers (native, native greedy, EB greedy, renoise, renoise greedy); AR tunes temperature sampling and greedy decoding, one call per token
one training seed; the validation winner is scored once on the test split (seeds 1041, 1042)
masked uses the ELBO weighting; Gaussian uses the CDCD learned clock
notes: Each ladder recipe composes configs/sweep/common.yaml itself (see the sc-vs-depth panel for its settings).
Tokenizers: artifacts/tokenizers/tinystories-bpe/ holds bpe-{260,500,1000,5000,10000}.json with SHA256SUMS.
In hybrid_renoising.yaml the renoise policies are named renoising and renoising_greedy; the post calls them renoise sample and renoise greedy.

sweep.text:
# @package _global_
# Does the tokenizer change the picture? TinyStories with byte-level BPE at five
# vocabulary sizes x seven recipes (Gaussian embedding, masked ELBO and uniform
# posterior-CE diffusion, each without and with self-conditioning, plus an
# autoregressive model) = 35 cases. See experiments/tokenizer-ladder/README.md.
defaults:
- /ladder_recipe: masked
- override /task: battery/tinystories_bpe
- _self_
bpe:
  vocabulary_size: 10000
  # Sequence capacity per vocabulary: every story of the shared cohort
  # (data.allowed_ids_path) fits at every vocabulary.
  capacity:
    '260': 1024
    '500': 768
    '1000': 512
    '5000': 512
    '10000': 512
task:
  length: ${oc.select:'bpe.capacity.${bpe.vocabulary_size}'}
  calculate_bleu: true
  num_eval_samples: 100000000
data:
  # The story cohort the evaluation indices refer to; build it with
  # scripts/prepare_data.py tinystories (see the README).
  allowed_ids_path: ${data.cache_dir}/allowed_ids.json
checkpoint:
  every_n_steps: 1000
preparation:
  name: tokenizer-ladder
  output: ${oc.env:SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT,${oc.env:HOME}/.cache/sddc}/plans/tokenizer-ladder
  family: tokenizer_ladder
  evaluation_file: experiments/tokenizer-ladder/evaluation/${preparation.task_name}.json
  wandb:
    project: tokenizer-ladder
hydra:
  sweeper:
    params:
      task: battery/tinystories_bpe
      bpe.vocabulary_size: 260,500,1000,5000,10000
      ladder_recipe: gaussian,gaussian_sc,masked,masked_sc,uniform,uniform_sc,ar

# Gaussian diffusion on learned token embeddings with a CDCD-fitted time sampler,

defaults:
- /experiment: corruption_factorial
- /sweep/common
- /ablation_path: gaussian
- /feedback: none
- /inference_policies: hybrid_renoising
- override /path_schedule: cdcd
- _self_
preparation:
  recipe_name: ${preparation.path_name}-${preparation.feedback_name}

# @package _global_
# Gaussian embedding diffusion (CDCD time sampler) with posterior-mean self-conditioning.

- gaussian

- masked
- override /feedback: expected_embedding

# @package _global_
# Uniform-noise discrete diffusion with a posterior cross-entropy, no self-conditioning.
defaults:

- /sweep/common

preparation:

# @package _global_
# Uniform-noise diffusion (posterior CE) with posterior-mean self-conditioning.
defaults:
- uniform
- override /feedback: expected_embedding
- _self_

# @package _global_
# Eight-layer causal transformer with cached sequential decoding. One model call per
# token, so the evaluation NFE is the sequence length.
defaults:
- /experiment: autoregressive
- /sweep/common
- /inference_policies: autoregressive
- _self_
model:
  n_blocks: 8
self_conditioning:
  enabled: false
preparation:
  recipe_name: ar-8
  evaluation:
    nfe: ${task.length}

# @package _global_
# Sampler policies for single-view diffusion recipes: the native (ancestral) sampler,
# its greedy variant, entropy-bounded greedy decoding and forward re-noising (sampled
# and greedy). Each is tuned on validation; only the best one sees the test split.
preparation:
  inference:
  - name: native
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: native_greedy
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, sample]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps
    sampler_overrides:
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
  - name: eb_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.parallel_entropy_bounded.ParallelEntropyBoundedSampler
      steps: 127
      freeze: true
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
      entropy_bound: 0.1
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
      sampler.entropy_bound: {type: float, low: 0.02, high: 0.5, log: true}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
      sampler.entropy_bound: 0.1
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: renoising
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.forward_resampling.ForwardResamplingSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      greedy_clean_estimate: false
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: renoising_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.forward_resampling.ForwardResamplingSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, sample]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps

# @package _global_
# Autoregressive decoding: tuned-temperature sampling and greedy decoding. AR makes one
# model call per token, so its NFE is the sequence length and no steps are budgeted.
preparation:
  sampler_budget_parameter: null
  inference:
  - name: native
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.commitment: [sample]
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.commitment: sample
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: null
  - name: native_greedy
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.commitment: [greedy]
    trials: 1
    budget_parameter: null

# @package _global_
# TinyStories with a saved byte-level BPE tokenizer (artifacts/tokenizers/tinystories-bpe).
defaults:
- /task/battery/tinystories
- override /token_space@token_space: tinystories
- _self_
bpe:
  vocabulary_size: 10000
  # Relative paths resolve against the repository root (artifacts/ is versioned).
  tokenizer_path: artifacts/tokenizers/tinystories-bpe/bpe-${bpe.vocabulary_size}.json
task:
  vocab_size: ${bpe.vocabulary_size}
  length: 512
  tokenizer:
    _target_: core.data.tinystories.StoryBPETokenizer
    path: ${bpe.tokenizer_path}
data:
  parquet_dir: ${oc.env:TINYSTORIES_DATA_DIR,null}
  allowed_ids_path: null
  max_train_examples: 2119719
  max_validation_examples: 21990
  cache_dir: ${oc.env:SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT,${oc.env:HOME}/.cache/sddc}/data_cache/tinystories_bpe
preparation:
  task_name: tinystories-bpe-${bpe.vocabulary_size}

# TinyStories BPE tokenizers

The five byte-level BPE tokenizers used by the tokenizer-ladder and BPE-10k experiments
(vocabularies 260, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000). They are versioned here so a clone has them;
`task=battery/tinystories_bpe` loads `bpe-<vocabulary_size>.json` from this directory by
default.

- Trained on all four training shards of `roneneldan/TinyStories` at revision
  `f54c09fd23315a6f9c86f9dc80f725de7d8f9c64` (`source-manifest.json` lists the shard hashes).
- Nested prefixes of one learned merge sequence; case and Unicode preserved; 260 is the
  minimum lossless byte alphabet plus four specials.
- PAD/BOS/EOS/MASK ids are 0/1/2/3; BOS/EOS are not inserted automatically.

Verify the files with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` (or `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`).

They were built with [`scripts/build_bpe_tokenizers.py`](../../../scripts/build_bpe_tokenizers.py), which also
audits full-story lengths at each vocabulary size.

questions.run:
# 0. Data the published runs used that is too large to commit (see the caveats).
python scripts/prepare_data.py text8 --parquet PATH/afmck-text8/data \
  --raw-dir $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/data_cache/text8/raw
python scripts/prepare_data.py tinystories --parquet PATH/roneneldan-TinyStories/data \
  --output $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/data_cache/tinystories_bpe/allowed_ids.json
# 1. Prepare the 24 cases (no training).
uv run --locked --extra tuning --extra scoring python -m core.sweeps.prepare -m \
  +sweep=continuous_schedules preparation.output=$SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/plans/continuous-schedules

# 3. Tables. With checkpoints present this also measures the schedules (one GPU: minutes;

  $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/runs/continuous-schedules --output $SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT/analysis/continuous-schedules

every recipe learns its clock with CDCD

# @package _global_
# Sampler policies for single-view diffusion recipes: the native (ancestral) sampler,
# its greedy variant, entropy-bounded greedy decoding and forward re-noising (sampled
# and greedy). Each is tuned on validation; only the best one sees the test split.
preparation:
  inference:
  - name: native
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: native_greedy
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, sample]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps
    sampler_overrides:
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
  - name: eb_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.parallel_entropy_bounded.ParallelEntropyBoundedSampler
      steps: 127
      freeze: true
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
      entropy_bound: 0.1
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
      sampler.entropy_bound: {type: float, low: 0.02, high: 0.5, log: true}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
      sampler.entropy_bound: 0.1
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: renoising
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.forward_resampling.ForwardResamplingSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      greedy_clean_estimate: false
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: renoising_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.forward_resampling.ForwardResamplingSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, sample]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps

# @package _global_
# Block diffusion: scale the encoder or the decoder? See experiments/block-encoder-decoder.
# 9 block models (configs/block) x 3 tasks = 27 cases, one training seed each.
# Masked block diffusion (MDLM loss, block size 32), time-conditioned AdaLN, no
# self-conditioning, 20k updates of 256 sequences, native samplers at 128 NFE.
defaults:
- /experiment: e2d2
- common
- _self_
# After _self_: a block model sets its depths, recipe name and recipe fields.
- /block: encoder8_decoder8
- override /task: battery/text8
algorithm:
  time_conditioning: true
trainer:
  max_steps: 20000
  accumulate_grad_batches: 32
  val_check_interval: 32000
checkpoint:
  every_n_steps: 1000
self_conditioning:
  enabled: false
data:
  # Read only by TinyStories: the story cohort the evaluation indices refer to.
  # Build it with scripts/prepare_data.py.

preparation:
  name: block-encoder-decoder
  output: ${oc.env:SDDC_STORAGE_ROOT,${oc.env:HOME}/.cache/sddc}/plans/block-encoder-decoder
  family: block_encoder_decoder
  evaluation_file: experiments/block-encoder-decoder/evaluation/${preparation.task_name}.json
  recipe_fields: [model, encoder_decoder, block_diffusion, representation, algorithm, parameterization, objective, noise_schedule, time_sampler, prediction, self_conditioning, optimizer]
  wandb:
    project: block-encoder-decoder
  # Native ancestral sampling only; renoising samplers were not run on these models.
  inference:
  - name: native
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.ancestral.AncestralSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      final_denoise: greedy
    space:
      algorithm.predictor.temperature: {type: float, low: 0.5, high: 1.5}
    initial_points:
    - algorithm.predictor.temperature: 1.0
    trials: 16
    budget_parameter: steps
  - name: native_greedy
    sampler:
      _target_: core.samplers.ancestral.AncestralSampler
      steps: 127
      epsilon: 1.0e-5
      final_denoise: greedy
      greedy_clean_estimate: true
    space:
      sampler.final_denoise: [greedy, ancestral]
    trials: 2
    budget_parameter: steps
